svg.title: LocalMind buildable MVP system blueprint
svg.desc: Ten sections show the local client, native lifecycle, conversation context, durable coordinator, tools, retrieval, inference, persistence, safety, and a future hosted deployment. Numbered main flows, bounded tool returns and asynchronous jobs are distinct. This is a proposed design, not implemented functionality.
svg.text: Proposed architecture · independent desktop installations · logical modules, not ten deployed services · 14 Nov 2026
REQUEST 1 compose → 2 admit → 3 persist → 4 context → 5 coordinate → 6 prompt → 7 infer → 8/9 tools → 10 validate → 11 stream → 12 commit
EXTEND = existing foundation BUILD = new contract LATER = outside MVP
Read results are evidence; writes require authority
I SAFETY, FAILURE HANDLING & RELEASE GATES
Cross-cutting contracts enforced at every boundary
Not required for the desktop MVP
No secret token in UI state
Reject or queue before model work
Persist accepted user message and run ID
Branch/edit history explicitly; no silent replacement
Current user turn + recent conversation first
Relevant scoped memory with correction history
Token budget includes tools, images and output
Never treat an inferred summary as a user fact
Pin permitted source versions for each run
Record selected IDs, dropped counts and timings
Distinguish retrieval miss from context-budget loss
No raw private document text in routine traces
Branches: waiting_approval / cancelled / interrupted / failed / needs_reconciliation
App-owned run contract + event sequence + attempt IDs + leases
Current tool status + evidence + output schema
No claim of web access without actual results
Model can propose a tool, not authorize it
Context sent only within the approved scope
Validate structured call and tool manifest
Read grant or exact write approval
Persist intent before external side effect
Result goes back as bounded tool data
Resolve citation IDs; assess claim support
Treat streamed draft text as provisional
Persist ordered deltas / batches before publish
Commit final message and terminal state
UI replays by sequence; rejects stale attempts
Short local transactions; no database transaction held during inference or approval
Usage/receipt state is durable. Summaries and analytics run off the response path.
Typed manifest + schema + effect class + grant scope + timeout + result-size cap
Allowlist executables and destinations. Untrusted tool text cannot grant privileges.
Version and argument fingerprint invalidate stale approvals.
Current fixture is not general MCP
Tool loop: propose → validate → execute → result → infer
The loop shares the run budget, cancellation state and remaining context allowance.
Reacquire GPU only for the next inference pass; do not hold it while waiting on a tool.
Every result has a call ID, attempt ID and status; prose cannot substitute for success.
Requires a real sandbox with filesystem/network/resource policies and package controls.
An ordinary worker process or a subprocess timeout is not a security sandbox.
Full hybrid: activate after both indexes are ready
No mixed embedding families, even at equal dimensions
Original query plus optional scoped rewrite
FTS5 exact terms + LanceDB semantic candidates
Return distinct retrieval status on failures
Check scope again before context/cloud dispatch
Citations bind to supplied passage versions
Human-labeled evals calibrate optional model judges
Migration rule: current 768-dimensional index is a baseline, not a universal schema
Local-only never silently routes to cloud
Do not load every model at once
Text / tool call / usage / stop reason / error
Cancel and timeout behavior per provider
No silent concatenation of different retry answers
Retry eligible failures before visible output
After output: preserve partial answer and retry choice
Respect model choice, privacy and cost ceiling
Auth errors and uncertain writes are not retryable reads
Later: user-operated vLLM endpoint; inference throughput is not a reasoning upgrade
H1 Transactional outbox + durable job queue
runs.db: state transitions and outgoing events commit together
Leases + bounded retries + duplicate handling + parked failed jobs
Workers consume only committed work; no Kafka or Redis dependency in the desktop MVP
Existing domain SQLite stores: messages and scope
New run ledger: events, attempts, approvals, receipts
Managed snapshots / artifacts; retention and backup
Native credential store is a separate security boundary
Stage timings + queue depth + categorized failures
Redacted local traces; opt-in diagnostics export
No claim that mocked checks prove live-model quality
Atomicity is per transaction/store; recovery reconciles domain updates across existing databases
Do not retry into a partial reply
tool result → next bounded model pass
Auth / membership → gateway → PostgreSQL + pgvector → object storage → shared queue → GPU workers; Redis/CDN/regions only when justified
Release scope: dependable chat + document comparison + screenshot/artifact flow + one curated connection + reviewed task + restart recovery. No promise of frontier quality from model count.
